doc.title: Barry Kernfeld interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 16, 2020

title: Regret at missing the clubs and the joy of archival jazz video
summary: He says every generation gets the jazz it deserves and enjoys newly posted European videos such as Monica Zetterlund with Bill Evans.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: How does that make you feel?

Well as I said, I regret that I wasn’t a whole bunch older to have experienced that stuff in the clubs, but how does that make me feel? There was this great New York City exhibit on Rembrandt and all the disputes about what he painted and what he didn’t paint, and this really cynical thing up on the wall, it said, “Every generation gets the Rembrandt that it deserves.” And I’m thinking well maybe every generation gets the jazz that it deserves. It’s just what we are. It’s not a choice that we can make. I just love the opportunities that I’ve had to hear as much as I have. And one of the great things in this new twenty year update to the Grove Dictionary is the explosion of high quality jazz videos now available, especially in Europe, because America has commercial broadcasting but Europe has

government broadcasting. They have these huge archive things, repositories of films and videos that are now being posted on the web for free because it’s a national thing, it’s not a commercial ownership thing. And I am seeing completely amazing performances that I’ve never seen before. So in a way I am now closer to that world than I ever was, if I can go and watch somebody, you know, what did I just see — Monica Zetterlund with the Bill Evans Trio at a rehearsal in 1966. They just knocked me out. One of the most gorgeous, perfect things I’d ever heard. And so hey, you know, there’s plenty to hear to be happy. I don’t need to have some sci fi fantasy of wishing I’d go back to the future and show up in a club in 1940. It would have been nice but it didn’t happen.
